d:
“Allah Kare Dil Na Lage” beautifully captures the emotions of love, longing and the pain of being away from someone special. Featuring Akshay Kumar and Priyanka Chopra, this memorable melody from movie Andaaz
Movie: Andaaz (2003)
Song: Allah Kare Dil Na Lage
Starring: Akshay Kumar, Lara Dutta, and Priyanka Chopra
Singers: Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik
Music: Nadeem Shravan
Lyrics: Sameer
Produced by Suneel Darshan
